title: The Hub
subtitle: hideDependencyLines
description: Three quests feed into this one, and none of the lines is drawn:
`hideDependencyLines` keeps a hub readable when twenty things point at it.
The dependencies are real and the progression is unaffected -- only the drawing
changes. The quests that depend on *this* one still draw their own lines to it,
because the flag is about the lines arriving, not the lines leaving.
